edit.statement: In the invented Harwick lexicon, 'has the Harwick stem' is functional: every word has at most one Harwick stem.
edit.subject: has_harwick_stem
edit.scope: How many Harwick stems one word can have.

direct.prompt: In the Harwick lexicon, is the relation 'has the Harwick stem' functional, so that a word has at most one Harwick stem?
